strongest_angle: Examine the extraordinary life and philosophical contributions of French philosopher Edgar Morin, who passed away in Paris at the age of 104 as the last survivor of a generation shaped by the Resistance and the architect of complex thought.

key_facts.fact: Edgar Morin, the French sociologist, philosopher, and resistance veteran, died in Paris at the age of 104.
Edgar Morin authored the monumental series titled La Méthode, which was published over a period of nearly 30 years.
UNESCO honored Edgar Morin, who delivered his centenary lecture at the organization in Paris.
Edgar Morin passed away in Paris on May 29, 2026, at the age of 104.
